title: Super Bowl Promotion Ideas for DTC Brands (2027): 8 Full-Price Plays
summary: Discover 8 Super Bowl promotion ideas for DTC brands that keep full price, from overtime rebates to subscriber plays, with Soul CBD's real results.
body_markdown:
## Introduction


The best Super Bowl promotion ideas for DTC brands keep the price where it is and give shoppers a reason to buy before kickoff. A conditional rebate does both.


Shoppers pay full price, get auto-entered, and win 100% of their order back if a published game outcome hits.


[Playably](https://playably.ai/) insures and hedges that payout, so you pay $0 of the rebate.


The usual alternative is a sitewide code that runs from Friday to the final whistle. It converts people who were already going to buy, and it trains the rest to wait.


This guide covers eight full-price plays for the biggest game of the year.


Each one is built around a goal: subscribers, first-time buyers, bigger baskets, cheaper ads or foot traffic. Where we have a real result, the numbers and their baselines are included.


### Key Takeaways


- Super Bowl promotion ideas for DTC brands work best at full price.
- Playably insures and hedges the payout, so you pay $0 of the rebate.
- Soul CBD's campaign buyers subscribed at 59%, against 41% of other shoppers.
- Pick the play by goal: subscribers, new buyers, baskets, ads or retail.
- Your team approves the brief. Playably builds and runs the rest.


## Why the big game rewards a rebate over a discount


The Super Bowl is a moment your list is already talking about. That shared attention is what a conditional rebate borrows.


A discount spends margin to buy attention. A rebate tied to the game gets the attention for free, because the game already has it.


Playably's homepage puts the trade simply. "Get the brand halo of the moment everyone's watching without paying to sponsor it."


The shopper side is just as simple. Buy at full price, and win it all back if the moment hits.


No discount, no code, no catch.


We covered the general mechanics in our earlier piece on[game day promotions for DTC brands](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/game-day-promotions-for-dtc-brands-2026-7-full-price-plays-and-what-the-overtime-rebate-returned) . This one is specific to the Super Bowl, and it is organised by what you want the week to produce.


## 8 Super Bowl promotion ideas that hold full price


### 1. The overtime rebate


This is the classic. If the game goes to overtime, every campaign order pays back 100%.


Overtime is public, instant and easy for anyone to check. Shoppers understand it in one line, and nobody feels bad when it happens.


Soul CBD's OVERTIME Big Game Cashback ran from Jan 26 to Feb 7, 2026. The results are below, because each of them maps to a different play in this list.


Playably maps the trigger with you from its library of[pre-modelled sports moments](https://playably.ai/pages/upcoming-offers) , and new moments are added weekly.


### 2. The subscriber play


If you sell on subscription, make the rebate the reason to start one. Game week is when your list is paying attention, so put the subscription option front and centre on every campaign page.


Soul CBD's numbers show why. 59% of campaign buyers subscribed, compared with 41% of other shoppers that same week, which is 1.4× the subscription sign-up rate.


The subscribers also stuck. 63% renewed at least once, close to Soul's regular subscribers at 67%.


More subscription plays are in our guide to[increasing subscription signups on Shopify](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/how-to-increase-subscription-signups-on-shopify-2026-6-offers-beyond-10-off) .


### 3. The first-order play


Use the game to pull in first-time buyers who have been sitting on your site for months. A 100% cashback chance is a sharper first-order reason than 10% off.


In Soul CBD's campaign, brand-new buyers subscribed at 1.5× the rate of other first-time buyers, 54% against 36%. They came in at full price.


Point paid social and your welcome flow at the campaign page for the whole window.


### 4. The basket builder


Let the rebate ride on the whole order. If the trigger hits, Playably pays 100% of the order back, so a bigger basket means a bigger potential win for the shopper.


Soul CBD's campaign baskets were 16% bigger than the rest of the store, $99 against $86. Nothing was marked down to get there.


For more levers, see[how to increase AOV without discounts](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/how-to-increase-aov-without-discounts-7-levers-and-the-results-from-30-shopify-brands-2026) .


### 5. The rebate ad


A rebate gives your creative a hook that a discount cannot match, because "100% back if it goes to overtime" stops a scroll.


BlackBoxMyCar saw 18.25× ROAS on rebate ads during March Madness 2026. The same mechanic runs in playable ads around other sports moments.


The full breakdown is in our post on[improving Meta ROAS without discounting](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/how-to-improve-meta-roas-without-discounting-inside-the-18-25-rebate-ad-campaign-2026) .


### 6. The watch party QR


Plenty of brands sell through shelves, pop-ups and venues as well as Shopify. The same Play & Win loop runs there too.


"A QR on the packaging or a POS sign turns any shelf into an entry point." At a live event it is "a code on the jumbotron, a text after kickoff, a card at the gate."


One mechanic, every surface where fans are watching.


### 7. The channel workaround


Some categories cannot advertise freely on paid social. A rebate still gives them a game-week story to tell on email, SMS and their own site.


Soul CBD is the example. We covered what worked in[promotions for cannabis and CBD brands](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/promotions-for-cannabis-and-cbd-brands-that-can-t-run-meta-ads-2026-what-worked-for-soul) .


### 8. The custom trigger


Overtime is not the only outcome worth building around. If your audience cares about a different published result, bring it to the team.


"Got a different moment in mind? Bring us a trigger we haven't covered."


Playably models the cap for custom triggers too, and there is no published price for one, because each is modelled per brand.


Keep the trigger public and verifiable. The best triggers are events your shoppers are already talking about, which is what makes the campaign spread on its own.
